o1.biggest_strength: It correctly builds the whole series around the two retention signals: recurring tasks and a second device, with platform-specific second-device emails and a gentle inactivity nudge.
o1.biggest_mistake: The Pro email is probably still a little early and introduces a paid-feature pitch that is less central than the two core habits.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Tighten the Pro decision, maybe make email 5 a habit reinforcement or only test Pro after both habits are complete, and make the skip/segment rules fully explicit for every email.

o2.biggest_strength: It focuses on the right behaviors, uses the available triggers, branches by platform, and drops the weak current emails for the right reasons.
o2.biggest_mistake: The fifth email repeats the recurring-task ask rather than adding much new, and the main success metric shifts to day 14 instead of pushing the key week-one habit strongly enough.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Make the fifth email more strategic, clean up the measurement plan around day-7 recurring plus second-device completion, and remove small overstatements like the Pro email being one lost subscriber per click.

reason: I would rather use Output 1 because it is more polished, more complete, and closer to our brand as written. Output 2 has the right strategy, but it feels a bit more like a plan than a finished onboarding series.
